Phase 2: thumb spring glide and catch-up lag, rubber-band past limits, release momentum carry (project/SNAP_PX), limit-bump on keys, scale 1.16 thumb lift spring, bubble enter/exit, RollingNumber odometer wheels (Wheel/Glyph/slot variants).

No bits-ui primitive: ARC's slider is hand-built (role=slider thumbs, pointer capture), so the port is too.
Thumb scale(1.16) carried as inline transform on .thumb; CSS centres via `translate`, so they compose.
